title: Portal invitation payload
description: Payload of an invitation code 'ishtaria-invite:v1.<payload>.<signature>' (both base64url without padding). The signature is Ed25519 over the bytes 'ishtaria/portal-invitation/v1' + 0x00 + the decoded payload, made with the issuing world's key. Single use; at most 30 days of validity.

world.description: DNS name of a world (its permanent identity).

player.description: Account name (localpart) on the issuing world.

api_url.description: Public API URL of the issuing world; the invited world fetches /.well-known/ishtaria/server.json from it.
